     4	
     5	OSSInsight is a free analytics platform that tracks over **10.6 billion GitHub events** in real time, covering stars, commits, pull requests, issues, contributors, and community health metrics across the entire open-source ecosystem. The trending rankings are computed using a composite score: **Total Score = Stars Score + Forks Score + Base Score**, providing a balanced view of repository momentum beyond raw star counts alone.

Rust appears twice, while Verilog, HTML, JavaScript, Dart, and Shell each contribute one project.     46	
    47	A striking **14 out of 20 (70%)** trending repositories are directly related to AI agents, LLM-powered coding assistants, or developer productivity tools. Key sub-themes include:
    48	
    49	- **Autonomous coding agents**: multica-ai/multica, vercel-labs/open-agents, and lsdefine/GenericAgent enable AI to autonomously write code, handle issues, and execute desktop tasks.
    50	- **Token optimization**: JuliusBrussee/caveman and rtk-ai/rtk focus on slashing LLM token consumption by 60–90%, addressing cost and latency concerns.
    51	- **Memory & context management**: thedotmack/claude-mem captures and compresses coding session context for future injection, while safishamsi/graphify converts codebases into queryable knowledge graphs.

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 1200, 1700
BG_COLOR = (15, 23, 42)          # deep navy / slate-950
CARD_BG = (30, 41, 59)           # slate-800
ACCENT_BLUE = (56, 189, 248)     # electric blue
ACCENT_GREEN = (74, 222, 128)    # vibrant green
ACCENT_AMBER = (251, 191, 36)    # warm amber
TEXT_PRIMARY = (248, 250, 252)   # slate-50
TEXT_SECONDARY = (148, 163, 184) # slate-400
TEXT_MUTED = (100, 116, 139)     # slate-500
DIVIDER = (51, 65, 85)           # slate-700
AI_HIGHLIGHT = (14, 55, 48)      # dark green tint for AI rows

# Language colors
LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python": (56, 189, 248),
    "TypeScript": (99, 102, 241),
    "Rust": (239, 68, 68),
    "Verilog": (168, 85, 247),
    "HTML": (249, 115, 22),
    "JavaScript": (234, 179, 8),
    "Dart": (14, 165, 233),
    "Shell": (34, 197, 94),
    "—": (148, 163, 184),
}

# AI-related repos set
AI_REPOS = {
    "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills",
    "NousResearch/hermes-agent",
    "thedotmack/claude-mem",
    "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",
    "JuliusBrussee/caveman",
    "multica-ai/multica",
    "safishamsi/graphify",
    "jamiepine/voicebox",
    "lsdefine/GenericAgent",
    "rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch",
    "EvoMap/evolver",
    "google/magika",
    "vercel-labs/open-agents",
    "alchaincyf/nuwa-skill",
}

REPOS = [
    ("forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "—", 826, 79, 0, 0),
    ("NousResearch/hermes-agent", "Python", 468, 102, 66, 61),
    ("NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR", "Verilog", 353, 81, 5, 0),
    ("thedotmack/claude-mem", "TypeScript", 335, 33, 4, 0),
    ("VoltAgent/awesome-design-md", "HTML", 321, 49, 0, 0),
    ("JuliusBrussee/caveman", "Python", 237, 19, 0, 3),
    ("multica-ai/multica", "TypeScript", 139, 13, 44, 10),
    ("safishamsi/graphify", "Python", 120, 13, 0, 1),
    ("jamiepine/voicebox", "TypeScript", 100, 12, 8, 3),
    ("lsdefine/GenericAgent", "Python", 101, 9, 5, 2),
    ("rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch", "Python", 82, 19, 0, 0),
    ("EvoMap/evolver", "JavaScript", 95, 5, 1, 1),
    ("google/magika", "Python", 122, 7, 0, 3),
    ("vercel-labs/open-agents", "TypeScript", 84, 12, 2, 12),
    ("thunderbird/thunderbolt", "TypeScript", 82, 4, 7, 0),
    ("alchaincyf/nuwa-skill", "Python", 67, 17, 0, 0),
    ("BasedHardware/omi", "Dart", 111, 72, 9, 7),
    ("farion1231/cc-switch", "Rust", 77, 6, 5, 0),
    ("SimoneAvogadro/android-reverse-engineering-skill", "Shell", 77, 0, 0, 0),
    ("rtk-ai/rtk", "Rust", 73, 4, 2, 1),
]

METRICS = [
    ("10.6B+", "GitHub Events\nTracked"),
    ("826", "Top Repo Stars\n(24h)"),
    ("14 / 20", "AI/Agent-Related\nRepos (70%)"),
    ("Python", "Most Common\nLanguage (7)"),
    ("3,254", "Total Stars\nAcross Top 10"),
]

LANG_DATA = [
    ("Python", 7, 0.35),
    ("TypeScript", 5, 0.25),
    ("Rust", 2, 0.10),
    ("Others", 6, 0.30),
]

THEMES = [
    ("Autonomous Coding Agents", "multica, open-agents, GenericAgent enable AI to write code & handle issues autonomously."),
    ("Token Optimization", "caveman & rtk slash LLM token consumption by 60–90%, cutting cost & latency."),
    ("Memory & Context", "claude-mem compresses session context; graphify turns codebases into queryable knowledge graphs."),
    ("Skill Distillation", "#1 repo and nuwa-skill package expert mental models as reusable AI skills."),
]

# ============================================================
# FONTS
# ============================================================
def get_font(size, bold=False, mono=False):
    families = []
    if mono:
        families = ["DejaVu Sans Mono", "Liberation Mono", "FreeMono"]
    elif bold:
        families = ["DejaVu Sans", "Liberation Sans", "FreeSans"]
    else:
        families = ["DejaVu Sans", "Liberation Sans", "FreeSans"]
    for fam in families:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(fam + ".ttf", size)
        except:
            pass
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ============================================================
# DRAWING HELPERS
# ============================================================
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def draw_text_centered(draw, text, y, font, fill, width_limit=None):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    x = (WIDTH - tw) // 2
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_text_right(draw, text, x, y, font, fill):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

# ============================================================
# BUILD POSTER
# ============================================================
img = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT), BG_COLOR)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# --- Decorative top gradient bar ---
for i in range(6):
    draw.rectangle([(0, i), (WIDTH, i+1)], fill=(30+i*8, 41+i*8, 59+i*8))

# --- Title ---
title_font = get_font(44, bold=True)
subtitle_font = get_font(20)
draw_text_centered(draw, "GitHub's Hottest Repos", 30, title_font, TEXT_PRIMARY)
draw_text_centered(draw, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", 82, subtitle_font, ACCENT_BLUE)

# --- Hero Metrics Row ---
metric_y = 130
metric_card_w = 210
metric_card_h = 100
metric_gap = 18
start_x = (WIDTH - (5 * metric_card_w + 4 * metric_gap)) // 2

for idx, (val, label) in enumerate(METRICS):
    x = start_x + idx * (metric_card_w + metric_gap)
    # card bg
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, metric_y, x + metric_card_w, metric_y + metric_card_h), 10, CARD_BG)
    # accent top line
    accent = ACCENT_GREEN if idx == 2 else ACCENT_BLUE
    draw.rectangle([(x, metric_y), (x + metric_card_w, metric_y + 4)], fill=accent)
    # value
    val_font = get_font(28, bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), val, font=val_font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (metric_card_w - tw)//2, metric_y + 18), val, font=val_font, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    # label
    lab_font = get_font(13)
    lines = label.split("\n")
    ly = metric_y + 55
    for line in lines:
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), line, font=lab_font)
        tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
        draw.text((x + (metric_card_w - tw)//2, ly), line, font=lab_font, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY)
        ly += 18

# --- Section: Top 20 Table ---
table_y = 260
draw.text((50, table_y), "TOP 20 TRENDING REPOSITORIES (PAST 24 HOURS)", font=get_font(18, bold=True), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
draw.line([(50, table_y + 28), (WIDTH - 50, table_y + 28)], fill=DIVIDER, width=1)

# Table headers
header_y = table_y + 38
col_x = [50, 90, 340, 510, 610, 710, 810, 940]
headers = ["#", "Repository", "Language", "Stars", "Forks", "Pushes", "PRs", "Category"]
header_font = get_font(13, bold=True)
for cx, h in zip(col_x, headers):
    draw.text((cx, header_y), h, font=header_font, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

# Table rows
row_h = 36
row_start_y = header_y + 26
for i, (repo, lang, stars, forks, pushes, prs) in enumerate(REPOS):
    y = row_start_y + i * row_h
    is_ai = repo in AI_REPOS
    # subtle row bg for AI
    if is_ai:
        draw.rectangle([(46, y - 4), (WIDTH - 46, y + row_h - 4)], fill=AI_HIGHLIGHT)
    # rank
    rank_color = ACCENT_AMBER if i < 3 else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw.text((col_x[0], y), f"{i+1}", font=get_font(14, bold=True), fill=rank_color)
    # repo name (truncated if needed)
    repo_display = repo
    if len(repo_display) > 32:
        repo_display = repo_display[:29] + "..."
    draw.text((col_x[1], y), repo_display, font=get_font(14, mono=True), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    # language with dot
    lang_color = LANG_COLORS.get(lang, TEXT_SECONDARY)
    draw.ellipse([(col_x[2] - 18, y + 6), (col_x[2] - 8, y + 16)], fill=lang_color)
    draw.text((col_x[2], y), lang, font=get_font(13), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY)
    # metrics
    data_font = get_font(13)
    draw.text((col_x[3], y), f"{stars:,}", font=data_font, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    draw.text((col_x[4], y), f"{forks:,}", font=data_font, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    draw.text((col_x[5], y), str(pushes), font=data_font, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    draw.text((col_x[6], y), str(prs), font=data_font, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    # category badge
    badge_text = "AI / Agent" if is_ai else "Other"
    badge_color = ACCENT_GREEN if is_ai else TEXT_MUTED
    badge_bg = (20, 40, 30) if is_ai else (40, 40, 40)
    badge_font = get_font(11)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), badge_text, font=badge_font)
    btw = bbox[2] - bbox[0] + 12
    bth = 20
    bx = col_x[7]
    by = y + 1
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (bx, by, bx + btw, by + bth), 4, badge_bg, outline=badge_color, width=1)
    draw.text((bx + 6, by + 3), badge_text, font=badge_font, fill=badge_color)

# --- Section: Language Breakdown & AI Dominance ---
section2_y = row_start_y + 20 * row_h + 30
draw.text((50, section2_y), "LANGUAGE & CATEGORY BREAKDOWN", font=get_font(18, bold=True), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
draw.line([(50, section2_y + 28), (WIDTH - 50, section2_y + 28)], fill=DIVIDER, width=1)

# Horizontal bar chart for languages
chart_y = section2_y + 45
bar_max_w = 380
bar_h = 22
for idx, (lang, count, share) in enumerate(LANG_DATA):
    y = chart_y + idx * 38
    color = LANG_COLORS.get(lang, ACCENT_BLUE)
    # label
    draw.text((50, y), lang, font=get_font(14, bold=True), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
    # bar bg
    draw.rectangle([(160, y + 2), (160 + bar_max_w, y + 2 + bar_h)], fill=DIVIDER)
    # bar fill
    fill_w = int(bar_max_w * share)
    draw.rectangle([(160, y + 2), (160 + fill_w, y + 2 + bar_h)], fill=color)
    # count + pct
    draw.text((160 + bar_max_w + 12, y), f"{count}  ({share:.0%})", font=get_font(13), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Big stat callout on the right side
stat_x = 640
stat_y = chart_y + 10
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (stat_x, stat_y, stat_x + 510, stat_y + 140), 14, CARD_BG)
draw.rectangle([(stat_x, stat_y), (stat_x + 510, stat_y + 5)], fill=ACCENT_GREEN)

draw.text((stat_x + 20, stat_y + 18), "14 out of 20", font=get_font(38, bold=True), fill=ACCENT_GREEN)
draw.text((stat_x + 20, stat_y + 68), "repositories are AI/agent-related", font=get_font(18), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
draw.text((stat_x + 20, stat_y + 96), "That's 70% of the entire trending list — open source is racing to build", font=get_font(13), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY)
draw.text((stat_x + 20, stat_y + 116), "the infrastructure for AI-augmented software development.", font=get_font(13), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# --- Section: Key Themes ---
section3_y = section2_y + 200
draw.text((50, section3_y), "KEY THEMES: AI AGENTS, TOKEN OPTIMIZATION & KNOWLEDGE GRAPHS", font=get_font(18, bold=True), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY)
draw.line([(50, section3_y + 28), (WIDTH - 50, section3_y + 28)], fill=DIVIDER, width=1)

theme_card_w = 540
theme_card_h = 90
theme_gap_x = 20
theme_gap_y = 16
for idx, (title, desc) in enumerate(THEMES):
    col = idx % 2
    row = idx // 2
    x = 50 + col * (theme_card_w + theme_gap_x)
    y = section3_y + 40 + row * (theme_card_h + theme_gap_y)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x + theme_card_w, y + theme_card_h), 10, CARD_BG)
    # accent left bar
    draw.rectangle([(x, y), (x + 5, y + theme_card_h)], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    draw.text((x + 18, y + 12), title, font=get_font(15, bold=True), fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    # wrap desc
    words = desc.split()
    lines = []
    cur = ""
    for w in words:
        if draw.textlength(cur + " " + w, font=get_font(13)) < theme_card_w - 36:
            cur = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        else:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    lines.append(cur)
    ly = y + 38
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x + 18, ly), line, font=get_font(13), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY)
        ly += 18

# --- Footer ---
footer_y = HEIGHT - 50
draw.text((50, footer_y), "Data via OSSInsight  ·  Composite Score = Stars + Forks + Base  ·  Past 24 Hours", font=get_font(12), fill=TEXT_MUTED)
draw.text((WIDTH - 50, footer_y), "github-oss-insight.com", font=get_font(12), fill=TEXT_MUTED)

# Save
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG")
print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")

The poster has been generated and saved to `/app/output/final_poster.png` (1200×1700 px, RGB, ~177 KB).

### What the poster includes
- **Hero metrics bar** at the top with the five key stats (10.6B+ events, 826 top-repo stars, 14/20 AI repos, Python dominance, 3,254 total stars across top 10).
- **Ranked table of all 20 trending repos** with stars, forks, pushes, PRs, language dots, and an "AI / Agent" vs "Other" badge on each row. AI-related rows get a subtle dark-green tint for quick visual scanning.
- **Language breakdown** as a horizontal bar chart (Python 35%, TypeScript 25%, Rust 10%, Others 30%).
